facts.fact: WARDIP reports that the government approved the National Regulation on Interoperability of Digital Systems and Platforms of public and private services through Decree 27/2025, published in the Boletim Oficial of 31 October 2025, setting common technical standards so systems can exchange data.

note: No fact on use: the page does not say public bodies must follow the regulation, names no enforcing body and counts no bodies exchanging data under it.
